observed_test_selection: max(test.auc_prc, model, variant); retrospective, not deployable selection
secondary_metrics: AP and ROC AUC come from the same PR-selected candidate, not independent maxima.
threshold_note: HF reports recompute classical thresholded metrics at 0.5; archived candidates use their validation-selected thresholds. Compare ranking metrics only, not accuracy/F1.
limitations: Macro means and win counts are descriptive. No cross-study or test-best-selected confidence intervals computed; no new model chosen using test scores.
